title: Bridgeport Ferry
content: The ferry ride from Bridgeport to Port Jefferson takes an hour and 15 minutes, enough for a rapid impression in gouache.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)I used a very minimal set of watercolors:anthraquinone blue,transparent red oxide, with a touch ofnaphthol red, plustitanium whitegouache.
